interpretation: CORRECTION to the original documentation-based audit: in the installed autogen-core version (see 'autogen_core_version' below), LLMCallEvent and ToolCallEvent both auto-populate agent_id from MessageHandlerContext.agent_id() when emitted from within a message handler -- the normal case for a real agent's LLM/tool call. This field exists in the class's internal kwargs dict (autogen_core/logging.py) but is not part of the public __init__ signature and is not documented on the API reference page the original audit read, which is why the original 'no agent identifier field' claim was wrong. Per-agent attribution from the default LLMCallEvent/ToolCallEvent stream is intact in this version. AutoGen should be reclassified SAFE, not MIXED, on this axis; MessageEvent sender/receiver remain the only other identity-carrying fields and are unaffected by this correction.
